name: Cloudspire

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after 4 waves, or immediately when only one faction's fortress gate remains

categories.label: Own fortress gate defeated in the final wave
categories.labelVi: Cổng pháo đài bị hạ ở wave cuối
categories.hint: If your gate is defeated in the last wave, your fortress power counts as 0.

categories.label: Fortress gate health
categories.hint: Current gate health at the end of wave 4.

categories.label: Fortress advancements purchased
categories.labelVi: Số nâng cấp pháo đài đã mua
categories.hint: 1 fortress power per advancement owned (pegs placed) at game end.

winCondition: Primary goal: defeat the opposing fortress gate(s). In 2 players the game ends immediately when a gate is defeated and the remaining player wins; in 3-4 players it ends immediately only when one gate remains. Otherwise after wave 4 compare fortress power = gate health + fortress advancements owned.

endCondition.description: 4 waves, or earlier when only one fortress gate remains

notes: family: fortress-power-compare. Team play (2 vs 2): add teammates' fortress power; highest team total wins (entered per player here, sum manually). A player whose gate was defeated early still plays on in 3-4p games; if defeated in the last wave their power is 0. Solo/co-op scenario books are not modelled.
